console.cancelled.text: The recording was cancelled: the console stopped watching that source
console.cancelled.note: Why a developer console recording didn't start: meanwhile the window closed, picked another source or started another recording.

console.fileFull.text: The recording file took nothing more
console.fileFull.note: Why a developer console recording failed: writing to its file wrote nothing (the disk may be full).

console.tooMany.text: Too many developer consoles open at once
console.tooMany.note: An error opening a developer console window or starting a recording: Hive already watches for as many as it allows. Closing one helps.
